name: Bank of Jerusalem Ltd.
summary: Bank of Jerusalem Ltd. provides commercial banking services in Israel. The company offers deposit products, such as saving, digital, and checking accounts; structured deposit products; personal loans, such as new and used car loans, and loans secured by deposits; mortgage loans; and foreign currency loans. It also provides independent trading services on the capital markets, and investment advisory services, as well as interactive brokerage services; credits for residential construction financing, and retail SMBs; manages current accounts; and private banking services to non-residents.
